description: Your life is dependent upon YOU. #dreamlife #selflove #selfimprovement
transcript: Just because you're not having the same experience that someone else is having does not mean that their experience is not authentic. People are living their dream life. Become inspired by that. Become inspired so you can build your own dream life. Your life does not have to look like anyone else's. Become inspired by the world around you and chart your own path.
